plugins.name: bmad-est
plugins.description: Turns any project input — transcript, PRD, SOW, RFP or backlog workbook, in any format or language — into a traceable scope inventory and a defensible, ranged hour estimate for delivery with the BMad method. Band width is computed from how much the input actually said, so a thin brief cannot produce a confident number. Ships six skills: scope extraction with two-way traceability, the estimating engine, a planner that turns a priced estimate into staffed delivery options with a Gantt and a fresh estimate for each, a calibrator that learns from delivered actuals, Nadia the conversational delivery estimator, and the module setup.
